title: Rain on a Mountain Road
label: RAIN ON THE ROAD
description:
Rain on a mountain road after dark. A GT3 RS rounding a wet curve, headlights cutting through the mist, rain falling steady over the pines and the lake below. Eight hours of soft, even rain for sleeping, studying, or winding down after a long day in the bay.

No music. No talking. No thunder, no sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

Built for mechanics, car people, and anyone who sleeps better with rain outside.

Made by a mobile ADAS calibration tech. Absolute ADAS: https://absoluteadas.com
